principles: Do not optimize for the sake of optimization.
drivers: User needs confidence that closing these three gaps will not create new high gaps.
Current work request is a document, not code implementation.
Existing B-3a80 document is a triage plan, not a closure execution plan.

options.name: A: Add a dedicated resolution execution plan document
pros: Gives the user a concrete next-step plan without pretending the gaps are fixed.
Keeps implementation stories separate and bounded.
Can define anti-regression guards to prevent new uncovered future requirements.
cons: Adds one more requirements document and NAV entry.

options.name: B: Modify the existing B-3a80 triage document only
cons: Blurs triage with implementation closure and makes the previous story less stable as a historical record.

options.name: C: Start implementing the three gaps immediately
cons: Violates the current request for an execution document and risks mixing signed workspace work with future Layer4 Authority work.

chosen: A: Add a dedicated resolution execution plan document
rationale: Choose A because the user asked for an execution document, and the safest way to avoid new gap churn is to define exact follow-up work, closure commands, and future-scope wording before implementing anything.

preMortem.scenario: The document accidentally states customerKeyRef is current functionality.
preMortem.trigger: Using current-tense requirement language instead of future/blocked language.
preMortem.consequence: gap_analyze may report another high uncovered requirement or readers may infer Layer4 is unlocked.
preMortem.mitigation: Use explicit future/blocked wording and forbid receiptVerified/productionDone claims.

preMortem.scenario: The document claims signed workspace gaps are resolved by planning.
preMortem.trigger: Conflating resolution plan with implementation evidence.
preMortem.consequence: False closure of real REVIEW correctness issues.
preMortem.mitigation: State that closure requires separate implementation story, tests, and gap_analyze going to 0 high.

preMortem.trigger: Adding the new document without updating NAV count or link.
preMortem.mitigation: Verify NAV count and link with deterministic shell commands.
